scope: Construction of one explicitly selected three-chamber anaerobic-settling septic treatment facility STF-RC-3C-30M3-KS20 for 12 m3/day design flow and 30 m3 working volume, using 18 KS20.9 precast reinforced-concrete wall rings. Direct earthworks, foundations, precast components, joints, waterproofing, internal piping, baffles, ventilation, backfill, commissioning consumables, labor, mechanisms, QA and logistics are project-owned.
sourceAuthority: Approved wastewater and structural designer, precast component supplier, waterproofing specification, testing laboratory and approving project engineer
forbiddenClaims: complete municipal treatment plant, aeration tanks, sludge dewatering or external collection network
earthwork, concrete, component, labor, mechanism or logistics quantities derived from flow, volume or chamber count
automatic excavation shoring, groundwater dewatering or effluent dispersal field
universal retained spare or supplier-package quantity
